initial_failure: A saved approved plan without a run row returned not_found instead of exposing its durable admission.
fix: When no execution exists, read the scoped approved claim and return accepted, terminal=false, verified=false, source=approval_record. Chat shows the recorded approval and continues reading the original request; execution records take precedence once present.
scope: Private SQL tenant/principal/session/request isolation; cache-free HTTP transition from claim to original result with zero runner calls; frontend read-only polling of same request. Canonical migrated native suite passes. Frontend branch not separately browser-tested this turn.
checks: Ruff lint/format, ESLint and diff checks pass.
limits: This closes audit visibility before run creation, not automatic resumption after process death in that gap. A durable approval must not be treated as evidence execution started or completed. Claim lifetime, crash recovery, broader provider reconciliation and full acceptance remain open. No production deployment.
